# Orientation — the 10-minute tour

ticketd is a small internal support-ticket tracker: create a ticket, look at the list, close it
when it's done, and — separately — request/confirm a password-reset token if you're locked out.
It's one 122-line Flask file talking to SQLite, running since 2019, and it's being rewritten to
FastAPI + Postgres (PB-005) because a synchronous email call inside ticket-close took the whole
app down for ~40 minutes during a June 2026 SMTP outage (PB-001) — that incident is why this
workspace exists at all. Two other known problems (MD5 password-reset tokens, PB-002; slug
collisions on ticket titles, PB-003) are riding along; UI changes are explicitly out of scope
(PB-006), so every HTTP contract quirk the current UI depends on — including a `200 {}` instead of
`404` for a missing ticket (PB-007) — is frozen, not cleaned up, in this pass.

- Legacy pinned at `1cc113597ea8` (sha-recorded-clone)
